drafts.lead: Ben, Studiously — how would you find advancement teams struggling to reach young alumni
drafts.body:
Ben,

Good question, and the honest answer is that we do not go looking for teams who have publicly announced they are struggling, because nobody announces that.

We build the list from things that are visible: institution size, endowment band, whether they have an annual giving or young alumni engagement role, recent hires or openings on the advancement team, whether they have moved platforms lately. That gets us to the people who own the problem. Then the email itself does the qualifying, because the ones who are struggling are the ones who reply.

It is less clever than a signal and it works better, because the reply is the signal.

If you want to see the actual list logic rather than my description of it:

• Wednesday, August 12 at 1:30 PM EDT
• Thursday, August 13 at 2:00 PM EDT
• Monday, August 17 at 2:00 PM EDT

Pick whichever and I will send the invite.

Shannon
